title: Form → Notion + email
h1: Send Google Forms responses to Notion and email
opsNote: 4 operations per form response: 1 Google Forms trigger bundle + 1 Google Sheets Add a Row + 1 Notion Create a Data Source Item + 1 Gmail Send an Email. No AI module, so no credits are consumed — all four apps report centicreditsFormula: null and premium: false in the Make app catalog. The trigger Limit is 2, so a cycle that picks up 2 responses costs 8 operations. Counted from the module list, not yet measured on a paid run.

faq.q: Does this work on the free plan?
faq.a: Yes. Four standard modules, no premium apps, no AI credits. The free plan checks for new responses every 15 minutes.

faq.q: Why are the modules red after import?
faq.a: Accounts never travel inside a blueprint. Open each red module, pick or create the account, and the red disappears.
Yes. Delete step 2 and drag step 3 onto the trigger. The spreadsheet is there as a permanent backup of every response.
